_comment: The TG- roster: which MetaHuman becomes which companion.
`asset` is what Unreal opens. `name` is the character id this bake gets. bootstrap
LOWERCASES it, so `TG-Tom` becomes the folder, the .glb filename and the runtime id
`tg-tom`. Nothing downstream restores the capitals -- the display name a person sees is
the avatar row's name, set when the record is created, not this.
`body` decides the animation library and is NOT derived from the name. It describes the
rig, and a wrong one ships silently as female whatever the character is (telegamez#3285).
Every value below was read back from that character's own manifest.json rather than
inferred from the person the name suggests.
Hair calibration follows the ASSET, not this name: stage 03 embeds it into the sidecar
keyed on output_name, which stays the asset's name when --id moves the id. Seven of the
eight resolve. Tele5 has no entry, so TG-Jules renders with default hair.
TG-Jules is Tele5, not Tele3. Tele3's last export (2026-08-28) produced eyebrows and lashes
and no head groom at all, from a full stage 00 rebuild -- so it reflected the asset, not a
stale folder. Tele5 carries Hair_S_Coil properly, with MI_WI_Hair_S_Coil_Hair and its cards
material. It has no HAIR_PROFILES entry under any name, so TG-Jules renders with default hair calibration; no character on the roster uses Coil, so there is nothing to seed from.
